seo.title: Fishki — simple flashcards, smart reviews
seo.description: Create medical flashcards with text, images and cloze deletions. Study with quick review or spaced repetition.

hero.title: Simple to create. Smart to review.
hero.subtitle: Create your own flashcards with text, images and cloze deletions quickly, without complicated setup. Study with quick review or a spaced repetition system you can trust.
hero.validation: Built from conversations with medical students using flashcard apps.

comparison.heading: Why Fishki?
comparison.intro: Medical students need a fast editor and a serious review system. Today's tools usually deliver only one of them.

products.name: Traditional apps
products.label: Powerful, but complicated
products.text: Strong review algorithms, but a dated interface, difficult setup and slow creation of richer cards.

products.name: Simple flashcard apps
products.label: Simple, but limited
products.text: Pleasant and fast card creation, but too little control for demanding medical exam preparation.

products.name: Fishki
products.label: Simple creation. Advanced reviews.
products.text: A fast editor, flexible study modes and tools for images, tables and long medical answers.
points: Choice between quick and advanced study modes

features.heading: Work through difficult material faster.
features.intro: Practical tools that save time when creating flashcards and help organize study for classes, quizzes and exams.

offlineHighlight.heading: Studying should not depend on your signal.
offlineHighlight.text: Download exactly as much material as you need. A deck, folder or entire subject stays available without internet and progress syncs later.
offlineHighlight.places: At university · on a train · in the library · between classes

items.heading: Fast classic flashcards
items.text: Type a question and answer without unnecessary steps. The simple editor also makes creating cards comfortable on a phone.

items.heading: Flashcards from text and notes
items.text: Paste part of your notes, study guide or class materials and quickly turn the most important information into flashcards.

items.heading: Cloze deletion
items.text: Select key concepts in a sentence and turn them into blanks. Useful for definitions, symptoms, drugs, classifications and causal relationships.

items.heading: Images, diagrams and graphics
items.text: Create flashcards from photos of notes, lecture slides, atlases, tables and medical diagrams.

items.heading: Image occlusion
items.text: Cover labels, structures and parts of an image. Study anatomy, histology, dermatology, radiology and diagrams without retyping the material.

items.heading: Decks, folders and subjects
items.text: Organize flashcards by subject, module, exam or topic, such as anatomy, pharmacology or pathophysiology.

items.heading: Flashcard tags
items.text: Add tags such as “exam”, “quiz”, “difficult”, “drugs” or “symptoms” to quickly filter the material you need.

items.heading: Difficulty levels
items.text: Mark flashcards as easy, medium or difficult and return faster to topics that still cause problems.

items.heading: Review suggestions
items.text: Plan a deck review while creating it or add flashcards directly to the spaced review system.

stories.completed: Done. You reached the final study summary screen.

items.title: New deck → 2 cards
items.description: Create a deck, add two basic cards and study them through to the summary.
steps: Tap “Add deck” and create a new set.
Add the first basic card and tap “Next”.
Add the second card and tap “Save” to return to the deck.
Tap “Study” in the top-right corner of the deck.
Go through the cards until the summary screen.

items.title: New deck → cloze
items.description: Create a deck, add one cloze card and finish a short study session.
steps: Tap “Add deck” and create a new set.
Select part of the text, use cloze and tap “Save”.
Tap “Study” in the top-right corner of the deck.
Go through study until the summary screen.

items.title: Ready deck → study
items.description: Start studying from an example deck and reach the repeat-or-exit choice.
steps: Tap “Study” on one of the example decks.
Rate each card as “I know” or “I don't know”.
On the final screen, choose repeat or return to the deck.
